question: What did the leaders of Gilead promise to the man who would lead the attack against the Ammonites?
options: He would marry the king's daughter
He would receive a thousand shekels of silver
He would become the high priest
He would be head of all who live in Gilead
explanation: The leaders of Gilead said whoever took the lead in attacking the Ammonites would be head of all who live in Gilead.
